result.summary: The page is mostly clean, but the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab. This is the Home feed (delivery address, search, category chips, promos, restaurant lists), yet 'Profile' is shown as the selected tab and 'Home' is greyed out. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are expected scroll affordances.

issues.description: The bottom navigation marks 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) while the Home feed is displayed. 'Home' is grey like the other inactive tabs. This misleads users about where they are in the app.
issues.suggestion: Tie the tab bar's selected state to the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on this screen and 'Profile' uses the inactive grey style. Check that the selected state updates on navigation and on app restore or deep links.
